subject: MAP: FastPay security milestone — SOC 2 package deliverables & next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Rivers <alex.rivers@fastpay.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@fastpay.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft attached (security milestone focus)

Hi Alex / Olivia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) items focused on the security/SOC 2 milestone so we can get alignment on owners and dates. Attaching a simple MAP draft and the SOC 2 question workbook for your intake.

Key outcomes from the call:
- FastPay wants a single point of contact for the security intake (name + email).
- There are two prioritized asks: (1) SOC 2 questionnaire answers, (2) evidence delivery for key controls.
- Target go/no-go decision for production: end of July; security evidence needs to land earlier to review.

Proposed security milestone (initial):
- Milestone: Security review + SOC 2 package handoff
  - Owner (FastPay): Alex Rivers (security lead) — provide completed questionnaire + access to any required artifacts
  - Owner (Redwood): Ben Carter — produce evidence index, example artifacts, and mapping doc
  - Target dates: questionnaire answers due by 2026-06-17; Redwood to deliver evidence index by 2026-06-14; full evidence bundle delivery check-in by 2026-06-24.
  - Dependencies: access to FastPay audit logs (if required), agreement on PII filters/retention.

Please see attached: fastpay_map_draft_v1.pdf and fastpay_soc2_questions_v1.xlsx. If these target dates look tight, tell us which ones to move.

Next steps / asks:
1) Alex — confirm your security contact and whether June 17 is workable for the questionnaire.
2) Olivia — can you share the internal stakeholder list that needs to be on this MAP (legal / procurement / infra)?
3) Ben / Monica — we’ll start building the evidence index and will flag any blockers by 06/14.

Thanks — I’ll update the MAP after your replies.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
(t) 415-555-0182

Attachments: fastpay_map_draft_v1.pdf (PDF), fastpay_soc2_questions_v1.xlsx (Excel)

Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (security milestone focus)

Tessa — thanks for the clear recap. A few notes from our side: 

- Confirming I'll be the security lead but point-of-contact for evidence intake will actually be Olivia (olivia.chen@fastpay.com). I'll remain in the loop for technical clarifications.
- June 17 for the full questionnaire is tight for us because our internal risk team needs a round-trip review. Can we aim for June 21 instead?
- On artifacts: we can provide system diagrams and config snapshots but logs will require redact/aggregation. Any specific formats you prefer (CSV/json)?

Also, one ask: can Redwood provide a short sample evidence set (a redacted artifact example) so our risk team can validate expectation of what 'evidence' looks like?

Best,
Alex Rivers
Head of Security, FastPay
alex.rivers@fastpay.com

Quick note on dependencies and a small ask from our side: 

- Access: if you share S3 bucket paths / read-only credentials for artifacts we can validate faster. If not possible, we can accept zipped redacted artifacts via secure link.
- Redaction guidance: please remove any customer-identifying PII from logs; a hash or tokenized ID is fine for mapping.
- Timing: we can produce the sample artifact by EOD Sunday (06/14) and the evidence_index.csv is attached here.

One thing to flag: if FastPay requires system-level logs spanning a 90-day window, that will add effort on both sides. Can we limit initial evidence to the last 30 days unless your auditors require more?

Thanks, team — this looks workable. A couple quick confirmations:

- Olivia will own the questionnaire and will aim to return answers by 2026-06-21 as discussed.
- We'll provide redacted artifacts via a secure Drive link; IT will prepare a 30-day logs export by EOD Monday (06/15) and redact PII per the guidance.

If you're aligned on the turnaround SLA, Olivia and I will proceed with internal signoffs and share the Drive link when ready.
